ModelMind.line: AI education felt backwards, so I built the course I wanted people to have first.
ModelMind.proof: Live on the App Store for iPhone, iPad, and Mac.

Paper Rooms.line: Safari tabs ate my research life, so I built a library.
Paper Rooms.proof: Built and shipped solo in under a week.

our4cuts.line: An iPad and a browser are all you need for a photo booth.
our4cuts.proof: Live and used at real events.

Civic Forges.line: I wanted a city builder where running the city and living a life are the same game.
Civic Forges.proof: On the App Store and playable in the browser, with persistent saves and 36 automated tests.

Not Recommended.line: YouTube should begin with a question, not an infinite feed.
Not Recommended.proof: No accounts, analytics, ads, or remote executable code.
Not Recommended.status: Live on the Chrome Web Store

Hearth.line: The notch could be a quiet home for the context I keep reaching for.
Hearth.proof: Runs locally on macOS, with deterministic tests for transcript parsing and conversation status.

HeyContext.line: Context kept disappearing, so we built a workspace around memory.
HeyContext.proof: Went live with hundreds of users within a month, no ad spend.

HeyContent.line: Creators had context everywhere and nowhere, so we tried to bring it into one place.
HeyContent.proof: 5+ platforms integrated with real-time sync. The memory layer survived into the next company.

Brink Mind.line: Mental health tools ignored the body, so Brink Mind brought heart data into the room.
Brink Mind.proof: Reached TestFlight with working voice, biometrics, and on-device inference.

site-spec.line: A website can look finished while everything machines need is quietly broken.
site-spec.proof: Live-URL and local audits, JSON output, CI-ready exit codes, deterministic site builds.

Nexus Office.line: Agents that keep working without you need a place where you can see and answer them.
Nexus Office.proof: Public MIT repo with live Mac and phone clients.

renderstate.line: A screen should be inspectable in every meaningful state before the whole app can run.
renderstate.proof: Published on npm with multi-viewport capture.

KERNEL.line: Claude Code kept starting over, so I built memory, rules, and receipts around it.
KERNEL.proof: 360 commits since January 2026, on the Claude plugin marketplace.
KERNEL.status: Active, on the Claude plugin marketplace

llm-bench.line: Leaderboards were not answering my questions, so I made tests that did.

the-agent-library.line: Prompt collections kept rotting, so I turned repeated workflows into portable skills.
the-agent-library.proof: 39 skills, each extracted from repeated real-world use.

model-familiarity-engine.line: I wanted to know what a model had earned across a working relationship, not where it ranked.
model-familiarity-engine.proof: Replay-bootstrap loop shipped: redaction, replay, observed model cards.

metabrain.line: Memory gets noisy unless it has to prove itself.
metabrain.proof: Published on PyPI. Zero dependencies by design.

agentmailkit.line: A scheduled email should look the same every day, even when a model writes the words.
agentmailkit.proof: 36 offline, deterministic tests. Dry runs cannot send, enforced in code.

Substrate.line: I wanted to see what an unattended creative pipeline would become if it kept going.
Substrate.proof: 425 pieces and counting, generated daily without supervision.

latent-diagnostics.line: Correct answers were not enough. I wanted to know whether the model computed something real.
latent-diagnostics.proof: The failed hypothesis is documented next to the confirmed one.

paragraphs: Part architect, part systems thinker, part compulsive maker.
I started as a language person. Then language models arrived, and the language part and the machine part stopped feeling separate.
My career has been a sequence of frictions. I live with something until it annoys me enough to build a system around it, usually one that does the mechanical work so the person doesn't have to.
Today I'm CTO at Thinking Brain School, where I lead the design and operation of its autonomous AI system: architecture, orchestration, quality controls, and making sure the work is verifiable.
